name: synthetic_execpolicy_nested_alts
description: Nested alternative groups parse correctly: pattern=["git", ["push", "fetch"]] yields a two-token prefix rule whose second token is the alternative set, so the rule prompts on git push/git fetch only. Other git subcommands match no rule and fall through to the default allow. Originally pinned the pre-fix degradation to a bare ["git"] prefix (#3086); updated to the narrowed expectations after the parser fix (#3091).
